intended_object: This picks a fresh dummy variable: the 0th variable not among the free variables of the class term `Class.cv (nb095AlphaDummy409 D R S_cls E)`. The docstring describes it as part of a machine-checked nominal proof certificate (`nb095_alpha_dummy_421`), used for alpha-renaming.
explanation: This is an auxiliary definition. It chooses a fresh bound-variable name for alpha-conversion inside one generated proof certificate, which the docstring calls a "Checked nominal proof certificate". The name ("AlphaDummy421") and the namespace ("NominalAlphaWrappersRepaired") point the same way. The definition has no counterpart in the mathematical literature. It is an implementation detail of the library's syntactic proof machinery (one more sign of this: it takes the union of a set with itself), so it is not a mathematical object to compare with Mathlib.
